scope: Full official nuScenes val baselines, E1 error complementarity and four independent E2 single-step executable Oracle branches

segmentation.name: LitePT-S
segmentation.tta: Unmodified official small-v1m1 test transforms: initial 0.025m voxelization, 0.05m fragment voxelization, five scales and their flips
segmentation.probabilities: Float32 softmax votes averaged per point, restored to original order; argmax must equal native vote argmax

tracking.name: MCTrack
tracking.thresholds: Unmodified upstream CenterPoint online thresholds, applied to LION-Mamba
tracking.history: Capture once after native predict and before native association/update; reset at scene boundaries

seed: Per sample: first 32 bits of SHA256(pointtaskagent-20261029- + sample_token); fixed independently of sharding and restart
coordinate_contract: Raw points LiDAR xyz, native LION lwh+yaw, nuScenes global wlh and wxyz quaternion; joins by scene/sample/LIDAR_TOP token and timestamp
inference_ground_truth: No annotation boxes or semantic labels are passed into inference model inputs or candidate generators

e1.matching: Score-descending, same-class one-to-one nearest-center matching at 2m, using official detection filtering. This analysis operating point is distinct from official multi-threshold AP.
e1.detection_errors: For unmatched GT: classification error if nearest differently classified unmatched prediction is within 2m; otherwise localization error if nearest same-class unmatched prediction is within 4m; otherwise miss. Extra predictions counted separately.
e1.seg_to_det: For each detection GT error, >=5 in-box GT-class points, >=50% correctly segmented, and >=50% GT-class points supported by one predicted semantic cluster of that class. Whole-frame clusters generated without GT.
e1.det_to_seg: All non-ignore wrong points; also report 10 mapped object classes separately. Support requires correct-class 2m-matched detection containing the wrong point. Instance support means at least half its wrong points are supported.
e1.track_to_det: Seven trackable classes; a same-class pre-update historical box within 2m is support. Report first-visible/cold-start instances and unavailable histories separately.
e1.det_to_track: Scene-local class-consistent 2m matching; count missed output, ID switch and incorrect native association separately. Evidence requires current correct detection and a feasible same-class historical association within a fixed 4m gate, not merely presence of any box.
e1.confidence_intervals: 2000 scene bootstrap resamples, seed 20261029; never treat frames of one scene as independent samples

candidate_rules.all: Always include no-op; generate independently from full observable inputs; freeze serialized candidate artifacts before GT scoring. Deterministic order and budgets. Preserve failed and zero-gain attempts.

semantic_clusters.algorithm: DBSCAN on XYZ separately for each mapped object class; sort by descending point count then centroid

seg_to_det.geometry: XY PCA orientation; 2nd/98th percentile extents plus 0.2m; clamp dimensions to [0.5,2] times fixed class dimensions; reject oversized clusters
seg_to_det.replacement_score: Preserve existing matched detection score and velocity

det_to_seg.geometry: Only connected >=5-point components within the predicted box; require at least one seed with current predicted box class; preserve confident background and do not paint the entire box

track_to_det.candidates: History predicted box plus a bounded geometric center adjustment from current in-box LiDAR points; preserve dimensions/yaw
track_to_det.score: last detection score times exp(-observation age / 1s)
track_to_det.protocol_label: History-enhanced: scene-local Kalman state can depend on more than the official 10-sweep detection window; report actual history spans

det_to_track.candidates: Native association plus deterministic alternative one-to-one assignments obtained from current detection and historical prediction: center-distance Hungarian and single-edge forced assignments, preserving the native update/track lifecycle
det_to_track.replay: Oracle chooses one transition per frame; chosen tracker state continues chronologically; no future observations used

oracle.detection: Greedy fixed candidate order: accept a candidate only if it lexicographically improves (sum over 0.5/1/2/4m of TP-FP, negative sum matched center distances), with class-consistent one-to-one matching. Each original detection can be modified at most once. No-op wins ties. Official mAP/NDS are computed afterward and may decrease.
oracle.segmentation: Choose at most one candidate per detector region by increased correct non-ignore point count; evaluate only candidate-changed indices; accept strictly positive changes, no-op wins ties. Resolve overlapping regions in descending detector score order, each point modified at most once. Report full 16-class official mIoU, which need not improve.
oracle.tracking: Among frozen transition candidates, minimize the sum of wrong identity associations relative to prior matched GT instance identities and ID switches relative to prior GT-instance-to-track matches, then maximize matched outputs, then minimize center distance; no-op wins ties. State updates continue sequentially, and final full-sequence official AMOTA is mandatory.

metrics.segmentation: 16-class confusion matrix cross-checked against native nuScenes LidarSegEval; official IDs 1..16

execution.validation: One complete alphabetically first val scene for functional tests, retained in final full val; no metric-driven threshold tuning
execution.resume: Atomic per-sample predictions; tracker resumes at complete scene boundaries; manifests and protocol hashes required
